name: ISRCTN
summary: Registry of clinical trials: search trials by condition, intervention, country, phase, status or dates, and fetch one trial's full record.
notes: Keyless. Responses are XML, never JSON.
Formats: default (the stored record, recommended), who, ukctg, and internal (deprecated legacy format).
The query result has no paging: limit (default 10) caps the hits, and the result reports roughly how many matched. Split big queries by date range rather than raising limit.
Batch jobs should run sequentially, not in parallel. Any status other than 200 is a failure.

endpoints.name: Search clinical trials
endpoints.summary: Trials matching keywords and field constraints, with their full records in the chosen format.

q.description: Keywords and constraints joined by AND/OR, - to negate. Constraints include title, condition, intervention, conditionCategory, recruitmentCountry, recruitmentStatus, trialStatus, phase, gender, ageRange, funderName, sponsorOrganisation, fundingType; date fields (overallStartDate, overallEndDate, dateApplied, lastEdited) take LT/LE/GT/GE/NE with a full dateTime. Quote values with spaces.

notes: Date comparisons need the time part: lastEdited GE 2021-01-20T00:00:00.

endpoints.name: Get one clinical trial
endpoints.summary: One trial's full record by its ISRCTN.

isrctn.description: The trial's ISRCTN, with or without the ISRCTN prefix.
